FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=node:node package.json ./package.json
COPY --chown=node:node bin ./bin
COPY --chown=node:node lib ./lib
COPY --chown=node:node pricing ./pricing
USER node
CMD ["node", "bin/quote.js"]

# Shipping CLI
Run `node bin/quote.js` with an optional JSON argument containing integer amount and weightKg.
Default input is amount 4000 and weightKg 2. Negative values or malformed input exit with code 2 and INVALID_INPUT on stderr.
The application reads tariffs and prints a JSON shipping_fee and label. OPTIONAL_CONFIG=1 enables optional local labels; missing labels use the shipping default.
{"name":"shipping-cli","version":"1.0.0","type":"module","private":true}

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app

COPY --chown=node:node server.js ./server.js
COPY --chown=node:node view ./view
COPY --chown=node:node routes ./routes
USER node

# Template HTTP
Run `node server.js`. The service loads its HTML template before listening on loopback port 8080.
GET / serves HTML, /healthz returns status/app/theme JSON, and unknown paths return 404 JSON.
OPTIONAL_CONFIG=1 enables optional local theme settings; a missing file uses plain theme.

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --chown=node:node package.json ./package.json
COPY --chown=node:node src ./src
COPY --chown=node:node readers ./readers
COPY --chown=node:node pipeline ./pipeline
COPY --chown=node:node fixtures ./fixtures
USER node
CMD ["node", "src/job.js"]

# Settlement batch
Run `node src/job.js` with an optional JSON transaction array argument. Without it, fixtures/transactions.json is used.
Amounts are nonnegative integer currency units. Round each transaction fee to the nearest integer, ties upward; aggregate the individual fees and net amounts.
Print count, fees, settlement, label JSON to stdout. Invalid transactions exit 2 with INVALID_TRANSACTIONS on stderr.
OPTIONAL_CONFIG=1 enables optional labels and falls back to settlement when missing. No output files are written.
{"feeBasisPoints":250}
{"name":"settlement-batch","version":"1.0.0","type":"module","private":true}
